## Collection and evaluation

The collection contract identifies selected objects, returned fields, field datatypes/enums and unresolved physical acquisition. The evaluation contract references shared requirements, comparisons and cardinalities, and carries capability rules and comparison datatype overrides. It does not equate acquisition failure with absence. Complete missing/error decision tables remain unresolved, even when individual native rules are known.

Native references and legacy audit nodes occupy separate provenance branches. Legacy facts cannot populate native requirements without explicit adoption. Verified provenance means references match their recorded sources; unreviewed capabilities retain an explicit legacy-review gap.
